text:
At Casa Res in Francisco de Orellana, Guayaquil, the steaks were tender and delicious, and the potato purée delighted the palate. The moro rice, though mild, offered an intriguing taste.
The lomo de res, adorned with two eggs, was a harmonious ensemble. This Casa Res outpost stands as the pinnacle of my Ecuadorian culinary journeys. A commendable experience.

The moro rice, though mild, offered an intriguing taste. The lomo de res, adorned with two eggs, was a harmonious ensemble. This Casa Res outpost stands as the pinnacle of my Ecuadorian culinary journeys. A commendable experience.
